pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark, multi-sided polygons with starburst-like (stellate) projections. Edge gradients are high-contrast and jagged, with several acute-angled protrusions into the surrounding negative space. Spatial density is high relative to the corridor network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-tan network of non-uniform pixel thickness. Topological graph shows distinct tri-point and quad-point junction nodes. Pathways are significantly narrower than the patches they separate and are frequently intersected by foreground vegetation pixels.
